big_case.notes: Post-Groff Title VII undue-hardship standard with a 22-state amicus bloc, Groff himself as amicus, a call for response after waiver, and top-tier counsel: a genuinely consequential statutory question for every religious-accommodation case. But it rode a lapsed COVID-19 vaccine-mandate record with contested evidentiary footing, and the Court denied it silently off a single conference with no noted dissent, so the case itself ended without institutional footprint. Significant question, modest vehicle: mid-scale.
